# Nishree Attire

> Nishree Attire is an online saree store featuring silk, cotton, and designer sarees for celebrations and everyday wear.

## Store

- [Shop sarees](https://www.nishree.in/shop): Browse the saree collection.
- [New arrivals](https://www.nishree.in/new-arrivals): See recently added styles.
- [Saree collections](https://www.nishree.in/product_hub): Browse collections by style and category.
- [Find your drape](https://www.nishree.in/find-your-drape): Explore the saree selection guide.

## About and support

- [About Nishree Attire](https://www.nishree.in/about): Learn about the store.

- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.nishree.in/faq): Read answers to common questions.
- [Store policies](https://www.nishree.in/policies): Review shopping and service policies.
